result: I would eliminate human greed. Not suffering, not disease, or any external threat—but selfishness itself. The moment someone prioritizes power over wellbeing, we set in motion every cruelty, theft, and war humanity has ever known. Remove that one flaw, and suddenly all wars end overnight. No need for laws or police—people simply wouldn’t take what isn’t theirs. Institutions built on theft, exploitation, and manipulation would crumble because no one would have incentive to create them.
